build_doc_build_documentation: build the documentation of a Python package from Markdown and RST source files into MDX format
build_mdx_files_convert_markdown: build MDX files from Markdown and RST documentation source files for a given Python package
build_notebooks_generate_colab: build Jupyter notebooks from documentation files containing open-in-colab markers
resolve_links_resolve_internal: resolve internal documentation links in MDX files using an anchor-to-page mapping
resolve_autodoc_replace_autodoc: replace autodoc special syntax markers with generated Svelte documentation components
